versions.content: The J1939 Diagnostic Manager shall reject the state change by returning E_NOT_OK when the ‘newState’ is not in the valid range. If DET is enabled via J1939DcmDevErrorDetect, the DET error J1939DCM_E_INVALID_STATE shall be reported.
